headline: Emory & Henry beat Catawba to top the table unbeaten
dek: Emory & Henry finished the table a point above Catawba, the only side in it without a defeat, then beat Catawba at home. The sides' first meeting, at Catawba in September, had ended goalless.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 30 and conceded nine: the side top of the table got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Catawba outscored every other side in the conference and still finished behind Emory & Henry in the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Seven matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Lees-McRae.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's home win over Catawba was their tenth of the season; they have drawn three and lost none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's home win over North Georgia was their fifteenth of the season, against two draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mars Hill have scored 42 goals, more than every other side but Catawba, and conceded 26.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Héctor Vara has kept nine shutouts in goal for Catawba.

last_match.line: Catawba's first match since their defeat at Emory & Henry, the side they meet next.

next_match.line: A third meeting: the first, at Catawba, was goalless, and Emory & Henry won the second at home, and have yet to lose this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
